# Docs

- [Welcome](/docs): A plain-language guide to the Grievance Redress Mechanism (eGRM) — for the people who report problems and the people who resolve them.

- **For the public**
- For the public
  - [Using the public website](/docs/citizen): What the public website lets you do, and how to set it to your language.
  - [Send a complaint](/docs/citizen/submit): A four-step form on the public website. You can send it without giving your name.
  - [Check a complaint](/docs/citizen/track): Use your tracking code to see the current status. No account or password needed.

- **For staff**
- For staff
  - [Signing in](/docs/staff/signing-in): How to reach your work area, and what the main screen is showing you.
  - [Field Officer](/docs/staff/field-officer): Recording a complaint that someone brings to you in person, by phone, by SMS or on paper.
  - [Reviewer and Supervisor](/docs/staff/reviewer): Checking new complaints, sending them to the right officer, recording the outcome, and handling escalations.
  - [Project Administrator](/docs/staff/administrator): Creating a project, loading its regions, adding staff, and deciding how complaints are routed.
- On a phone
  - [The mobile app](/docs/mobile): What the eGRM phone app is for, how to sign in, and what the four buttons on the home screen do.
  - [Recording a complaint](/docs/mobile/record): The six-step Citizen Input flow — what to ask at each step, and what to hand back at the end.
  - [Seeing your work](/docs/mobile/reports): The complaints assigned to you, the figures for your area, and how syncing works when you have no signal.

- **Reference**
- [Screen labels](/docs/glossary): Every Kinyarwanda label on the staff screens, with its English meaning.
